def test_select_words():
    # Test with typical examples
    assert select_words("Mary had a little lamb", 4) == ["little"]
    assert select_words("Mary had a little lamb", 3) == ["Mary", "lamb"]
    assert select_words("simple white space", 2) == ["simple", "white", "space"]
    assert select_words("Hello world", 4) == ["world"]
    assert select_words("Uncle sam", 3) == ["Uncle"]

    # Test with n = 0 (words that are all vowels)
    assert select_words("a e i o u", 0) == ["a", "e", "i", "o", "u"]

    # Test with empty string
    assert select_words("", 3) == []
    assert select_words("", 0) == []

    # Test with no matching words
    assert select_words("hello world", 100) == []

    # Test case insensitivity of vowels
    assert select_words("AEI BCD", 3) == ["BCD"]
    assert select_words("AEIOU xyz", 3) == ["xyz"]

    # Test uppercase and lowercase mixed
    assert select_words("AbCdEfG", 4) == ["AbCdEfG"]

    # Test punctuation counts as consonant (not in vowel list)
    assert select_words("hello!", 5) == ["hello!"]
    assert select_words("a.b", 2) == ["a.b"]

    # Test numbers count as consonants
    assert select_words("abc123", 6) == ["abc123"]

    # Test single character words
    assert select_words("a b c d", 1) == ["b", "c", "d"]

    # Test multiple spaces between words
    assert select_words("  hello   world  ", 3) == ["hello", "world"]

    # Test result order follows input order
    assert select_words("lamb Mary little", 3) == ["lamb", "Mary"]

    # Test words with repeated vowels
    assert select_words("aaa bbb", 3) == ["bbb"]

    # Test n larger than any word length
    assert select_words("cat dog", 10) == []

    # Test 'y' is treated as consonant
    assert select_words("why", 3) == ["why"]

    print("All tests passed!")


if __name__ == "__main__":

def test_select_words():

    assert select_words("simple white space", 3) == ["white", "space"]

    assert select_words("", 5) == []

    assert select_words("a e i o u", 0) == ["a", "e", "i", "o", "u"]

    # Case insensitivity (uses .lower())
    assert select_words("UNCLE Sam", 3) == ["UNCLE"]
    assert select_words("HeLLo WoRLd", 3) == ["HeLLo"]

    assert select_words("hello", 3) == ["hello"]
    assert select_words("hello", 5) == []

    # Extra whitespace is handled by split()
    assert select_words("  Mary   had  a  little   lamb ", 4) == ["little"]

    # n larger than any word's consonant count
    assert select_words("cat dog", 10) == []

    test_select_words()
